title: Laboratory Supervisor
description:
JOB PURPOSE

This position is accountable for providing expertise to customers, related to all aspects of a project from sample collection protocols to analysis requirements needed to meet criteria of project, to QC and reporting of data in the geological services lab. The Geologist must be available to execute petrographic descriptions, data integrations with generated data and discuss results with customers, also provide interpretive reports when necessary.

QHSSE

Required to follow all QHSSE and Compliance policies and procedures and complete training by using all systems as defined by Stratum. You are responsible for creating opportunities for improvement, report and investigate incidents, non-conformities, and operative issues. Employees must submit STAR cards and report any risks identified on the job. Participation in meetings and general activities created to help in prevent risks is required. The employee is responsible to stop the job and assess whether the conditions are safe to continue work. If applicable, must be responsible for completing all required QHSSE and Compliance reporting.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Schedule, coordinate and organize personnel to execute the geological services.
  • Generate QC to the Thin sections elaborated on the TS Lab.
  • Generate Thin Section descriptions, mainly presalt samples.
  • Data Integration and QC within Thin section description, XRD, XRF, LPSA,
  • Generate interpretive reports and give presentations based on geological analysis.
  • Coordination between clients and laboratory personnel and management to receive, execute and/or send the samples abroad.
  • Attend meetings with clients for projects follow up and/or present the services.
  • Request materials and maintenance to complete the jobs in a timely matter.
  • Report generated revenue according Stratum policies and required dates.
  • Travel to conferences, training or support may be required on occasion in and outside of Stratum companies.
  • Must understand and comply with all safety rules and company policies of Stratum.
  • Know and understand Stratum Quality Policy and comply with all requirements of the Quality Systems Manual, Operating and Technical Procedures and Workplace Instructions.
  • Coordinate with other staff/labs to ensure samples are completed in a timely manner, and that proper protocols are followed.
  • Perform various other duties and activities as assigned by supervisor within the physical constraints of the job.

Skills and Knowledge:

  • Petrographic descriptions
  • Personnel Management
  • English and Portuguese languages

Minimum Qualifications:

Essential

  • BSc Geology or related

Preferred

  • 7+ years' experience

title: Estagiário de Arquitetura
description:
No Grupo Trigo, a gente leva a sério a missão de conquistar corações através do estômago

Somos uma das maiores rede de franquias do Brasil, a turma por trás de marcas incríveis como Spoleto, Koni, Gendai, China in Box, Le Bonton, Gurumê e 2V Deli & Conveniência.

Uma empresa que nasceu com o propósito de democratizar a boa culinária e que está crescendo em um ritmo muito acelerado. Quer saber um pouquinho mais sobre a nossa história? Aproveita e dá uma lida no resuminho que tem ali embaixo ;)

Vamos ao que interessa?

Se você curte um ambiente descontraído, ama inovação e aprender coisas novas, o Grupo Trigo é o seu lugar. Estamos em busca de um(a) estagiário(a) de Arquitetura para integrar o time de Projetos do Grupo Trigo. A posição atuará com suporte direto nos Estudos de Viabilidade para projetos de implantação de novos negócios e reformas.

E aí, se identificou? Não hesite em se candidatar agora mesmo.

  • Atualizar controles, planilhas e status dos projetos na plataforma oficial;
  • Dar suporte à comunicação com franqueados e fornecedores;
  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento de apresentações e materiais técnicos;

  • Familiaridade com Excel e Canva;
  • Noções de Gestão de Projetos;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão, como Trello e Planner;

  • Perfil organizado, com capacidade de gerenciar tarefas e prazos;
  • Agilidade e adaptabilidade em ambientes dinâmicos;

Remuneração: Bolsa Auxílio de R$1.400,00 (passando para R$1.600,00 no último ano de graduação) + Vale Transporte + Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (R$32,00/dia) + GymPass + Plano de Saúde Amil + Auxílio Farmácia OMNI + Convênio Sesc + Convênio com faculdades + Convênio com cursos de idiomas + Chances de Efetivação + Participação no Programa de Estágio + Chances de se tornar Trainee + Trilha de Carreira.

title: assistant marketing manager
description:
Company Description

Emerging as a pioneering French luxury hospitality brand in 1964, Sofitel brings French zest and inspires heartfelt encounters to the most sought-after destinations worldwide. Seamlessly melding local culture with the French zest for life through remarkable savoir-faire and generous service, Sofitel is for free-minded travelers and arts and culture aficionados who have an appreciation for a refined and understated sense of modern luxury.

THE HOTEL

Sofitel, a global reference in French luxury hospitality, announces the transformation of Sofitel Rio de Janeiro Ipanema into its first flagship hotel in Brazil, with an expected opening by the end of 2026.

Located on Ipanema Beach, the hotel will feature 172 rooms and embody the brand's contemporary vision of luxury, experience, and service excellence.

Join the team of talents who will bring this new icon of luxury hospitality in Brazil to life.

Job Description

THE POSITION

The Assistant Marketing Manager - Social Media, Brand & Content supports the hotel's digital presence and brand strategy, managing content and campaigns across social media, websites, OTAs, and CRM platforms. This role plays a key part in shaping the hotel's digital identity, creating engaging content, and supporting the launch of new or renovated properties. The position ensures consistent messaging, guest engagement, and alignment with revenue and brand objectives.

KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the digital and social media strategy for a new luxury hotel brand, shaping its presence from pre-opening through ongoing operations to express a refined, aspirational, and globally recognized brand identity;
  • Create, curate, and oversee compelling content across social media, digital platforms, and multimedia campaigns, highlighting the hotel's unique services, experiences, and lifestyle;
  • Develop and execute integrated digital marketing campaigns across Rooms, F&B, MICE, Spa, and other offerings to drive engagement, brand awareness, and revenue growth;
  • Manage pre-opening initiatives, including website setup, social media launch, and digital campaigns, to generate interest and anticipation ahead of the brand's debut;
  • Monitor digital performance, analyze engagement metrics, and optimize content and campaigns to maximize visibility, interaction, and business results;
  • Collaborate closely with marketing, revenue, and operations teams to ensure integrated strategies, consistent brand messaging, and high-end guest experiences;
  • Maintain a strong brand voice and identity across all digital channels, ensuring storytelling aligns with the hotel's global positioning;
  • Monitor social media trends, digital innovations, and best practices in luxury hospitality marketing to enhance the brand's digital presence/
  • Prepare regular reports on digital performance, KPIs, and campaign results, providing actionable insights to inform strategy and decision-making.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Hospitality Management, or related field;
  • Proven experience in social media management, digital content creation and brand marketing, preferably in luxury hospitality;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English. French is a plus;
  • Strong organizational, time-management, and project coordination skills;
  • Deep knowledge of current digital marketing concepts, trends, and innovations, with the ability to apply them strategically to elevate the brand's presence.
  • Proficiency in MS Office, social media management tools, and content creation platforms;
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work under pressure, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Job Category: Sales & Marketing

title: Retention Marketing Specialist
description:
UN/COMMON is a digital experience and marketing agency that launches and grows the world's best emerging brands. We believe the future of consumer-facing brands starts with creating authentic stories built for the consumer first and brand second. We are extremely proud to work with revolutionary brands such as Selena Gomez's Rare Beauty, Dermalogica, Liquid Death, Lemon Perfect, and more.

We are an employee and customer-centric agency bringing mission first brand stories to life to benefit the greater good and better people's lives. And we have a TON of fun doing it

The Retention Marketing Specialist owns the day-to-day execution of email and SMS production for our clients. This includes project management, content planning, copy and creative briefs, HTML builds, QA, and scheduling. You will manage end-to-end production and keep timelines on track across design, strategy, and client teams. You will work closely with a Retention Marketing Strategist to support retention strategy, reporting, and ongoing optimization. If you enjoy organized workflows, sharp deadlines, clean builds, and improving the customer journey through thoughtful messaging, you will do well here.

What You Will Do


You will manage the full production process for email campaigns and automated flows, build emails in Klaviyo or similar ESPs, write on-brand copy, create clear briefs for the design team, QA content and logic, and schedule deployments. You will maintain the monthly content calendar, drive timelines with clients, and ensure all assets and approvals stay on track. You will support the Retention Marketing Strategist by pulling performance data, analyzing results, and developing recommendations. You will build automated workflows, segmentation, and list logic, maintain list hygiene, and work confidently with Shopify apps such as Yotpo, Loyalty Lion, JustUno, and Privy.

Based on our projected customer base growth, we foresee the need for a Retention Marketing Specialist within the next 2-4 months to ensure we can effectively manage and nurture our expanding user community.

Requirements


What You Need

  • 2 years of experience in retention marketing, specifically across email, SMS, CRM, or loyalty programs.
  • Hands-on experience with an Email Service Platform (ESP), with a strong preference for Klaviyo.
  • Strong copywriting skills for direct-to-consumer (DTC) e-commerce, with the ability to adapt tone and style to match different client brands.
  • A solid understanding of email analytics and the ability to translate data insights into actionable strategy.
  • Clear understanding of the difference between marketing campaigns and automated flows, and knowing when to deploy each.
  • Proficiency in building segmented customer lists using behavioral and transactional data.
  • Experience working within Shopify or directly supporting Shopify-based clients.
  • A proactive, organized approach, with the ability to think through the entire customer journey and work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative team.

What Success Looks Like


Your production process is smooth, predictable, and organized. Clients trust your communication and follow your timelines. Email and SMS performance improves because of your quality and attention to detail. Strategy and reporting move faster because you stay ahead of data and execution. You keep projects aligned, informed, and on schedule. You take ownership, ask smart questions, and keep work moving forward.

Benefits


This is a contract position
Up to 40 hours weekly
Remote Selection Process

The selection process includes a video interview screening, followed by role-specific discussions (possible assessment) and a final leadership conversation.

Commitment to Inclusion


UN/COMMON is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees can thrive and bring their full selves to work.

About UN/COMMON


UN/COMMON has been recognized by Inc. Magazine as one of the fastest-growing private companies in America, reflecting our people-driven approach to growth, innovation, and excellence.

Agency Policy


Recruiting agencies are not authorized to submit candidates for this role. UN/COMMON does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from agencies.

title: Coordenador(a) de Controle de Qualidade
description:
Descrição da vaga

Nascemos em 2017 com o propósito de
Ser a Melhor Empresa de Saneamento PARA o Brasil.
Hoje, estamos presentes em diversos municípios e estados brasileiros, com o objetivo de contribuir para que o país alcance a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto.

Nosso modelo de negócios consiste em concessões e parcerias público-privadas (PPPs). Somos uma das principais companhias de saneamento do país, inserida na vida de comunidades de diferentes portes e atendendo milhões de pessoas.

Inovação, sustentabilidade, geração de valor e foco na satisfação do cliente fazem parte da nossa cultura organizacional. Venha fazer parte dessa transformação com a gente

Local de Atuação:
Rio de Janeiro, RJ (Iguá Rio de Janeiro S.A).

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Participar da elaboração do plano anual das atividades relacionadas com o sistema de gestão da qualidade, coordenar o levantamento e análise dos procedimentos existentes;
  • Coordenar, planejar e acompanhar os serviços voltados para avaliar a qualidade da água tratada e distribuída, bem como do efluente das estações de tratamento de esgoto, por meio de análises laboratoriais;
  • Coordenar a área sob sua responsabilidade, assegurando a correta administração de recursos financeiros, administrativos e de pessoal;
  • Dirigir veículos da empresa em caso de necessidade de serviço externo, zelando pela segurança e normas de trânsito estabelecidas.
  • Promover o atendimento e cumprimento das normas e procedimentos Sustentabilidade (Qualidade, Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Saúde).

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia Química ou Engenharia Ambiental;
  • CNH categoria B definitiva e válida;
  • Experiência com controle de qualidade;
  • Experiência com gestão laboratorial;
  • Experiência com liderança de equipe;
  • Experiência com gestão orçamentária;
  • Domínio no Pacote Office.

Requisitos Desejáveis

  • CRQ e/ou CREA ativo;
  • Conhecimento da Norma ISO 9001 e 17025;
  • Conhecimento no sistema LIMS e SAP;
  • Entendimento de tratamento de água e esgoto;
  • Desejável conhecimento no PNQS;
  • Experiência no segmento do saneamento (água e esgoto).

Na Iguá Saneamento valorizamos a diferença em todos os contextos e trabalhamos para promover uma cultura ética e inclusiva sempre. Como companhia e time, buscamos a equidade e respeitamos todos os tipos de diversidade (Gênero, Deficiência - PcD, LGBTQIAPN+, Étnico racial, Crenças e Gerações). Venha fazer parte dessa mudança, acreditamos na força de cada individualidade para gerar transformação

Informações adicionais

Nossos Benefícios
Aqui, cuidamos das nossas pessoas em todas as etapas da sua jornada como colaborador. Conheça o que oferecemos:

Saúde, bem-estar e qualidade de vida

  • Plano de Saúde extensivo aos dependentes
  • Plano Odontológico extensivo aos dependentes
  • Serviço de Telemedicina
  • Programa de Saúde Emocional com atendimento psicológico gratuito
  • Vacina da gripe anual sem custo para os colaboradores
  • Programas de prevenção e cuidados com a saúde com acompanhamento de portadores de doenças crônicas e estímulo de hábitos saudáveis
  • Acesso à rede credenciada de estabelecimentos diversos, como academias e estúdios (TotalPass)
  • Rede de parcerias e descontos em produtos e serviços
  • Programas internos de qualidade de vida: Mente Leve (para de saúde emocional), Convivendo (acompanhamento de colaboradores portadores de doenças crônicas) e o Enxuga (programa de estímulo de hábitos saudáveis) e Melhor Maternidade (acompanhamento de colaboradoras e dependentes gestantes, e crianças até 2 anos).
  • Seguro de Vida

Família e Apoio Pessoal

  • Licença maternidade (180 dias) e paternidade (20 dias) estendida.

Alimentação

  • Vale alimentação
  • Refeitório ou vale-refeição (conforme operação)
  • Voucher especial de Natal (em cesta ou cartão alimentação/refeição, dependendo da unidade)

Mobilidade

  • Vale Transporte ou estacionamento (conforme política interna e localidade da vaga)

Incentivos Financeiros

  • Salário compatível com o mercado
  • PLR – Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Empréstimo Consignado

Desenvolvimento e Carreira

  • Universidade Corporativa com trilhas de aprendizagem
  • Programas de mentoria pontuais
  • Os benefícios podem variar de acordo com a unidade, cargo ou regime de contratação, seguindo critérios de elegibilidade, entraremos em detalhe.

VENHA TRABALHAR COM A GENTE

Em 2017, nascemos com um propósito:
ser a MELHOR empresa de saneamento PARA o Brasil.
Desde então, nos consolidamos como uma das principais empresas do setor no país e estamos presentes em seis estados brasileiros (Alagoas, Mato Grosso, São Paulo, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro e Sergipe), beneficiando milhões de pessoas por meio de nossas concessões e parcerias público-privadas. Atuamos com o compromisso de proporcionar mais qualidade de vida e saúde à população atendida, por meio de um trabalho responsável e de excelência no fornecimento de água tratada e nos serviços de coleta, afastamento e tratamento de esgoto.

Mais do que uma atividade empresarial, encaramos a universalização do saneamento básico como um compromisso de larga escala com a vida, com as pessoas, com o meio ambiente, com nossos parceiros e com o desenvolvimento sustentável do Brasil. Esse propósito guia nossas decisões e reforça, todos os dias, o nosso compromisso em cada gota.

O nosso jeito de ser é marcado por um DNA inovador, que promove um ambiente acolhedor, respeitoso e repleto de aprendizados, gerando impacto positivo na sociedade. A valorização e o respeito às diferenças fazem parte da nossa cultura, promovendo uma atuação ética, inclusiva e um ambiente psicologicamente seguro para mulheres, pessoas com deficiência, pessoas negras, pessoas LGBTQIA+, independentemente de crenças, idade ou qualquer outro marcador social ou identitário. Buscamos equidade e respeito em nossas equipes e acreditamos na força de cada individualidade para gerar transformação. Já somos mais de
2.800 colaboradores
e seguimos com perspectivas de ir ainda mais longe.

Você já se perguntou qual é o seu propósito e que história deseja escrever para a sua vida e carreira? Sempre sonhou em ter um papel protagonista e impactar positivamente a vida de milhares de pessoas? Aqui, você pode fazer parte dessa transformação.

#VemSerIguá

Vamos construir um futuro melhor, Iguá Saneamento.

description:

Your assessment will be based on your technical skills and, later, in your behavioral interview. Please fill out all fields of your application with as much detail as possible, remembering that this is essential for your assessment in the anonymous selection process.

About Air Liquide

Through the passion and diversity of its people, Air Liquide leverages the energy and environmental transition, healthcare changes and digitalization, and delivers greater value to all its shareholders.

Join us for a stimulating experience: you will find a world of learning and development opportunities where creativity is at the heart of what we do, in an open, collaborative and respectful environment.

How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?

é responsável por planejar, coordenar e executar atividades de manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva em equipamentos, sistemas e instalações. Este profissional desempenha um papel fundamental para garantir a eficiência operacional, a segurança e a confiabilidade dos ativos da empresa.


• Executar tarefas de manutenção preventiva (PM), de acordo com o cronograma do local;
• Analisar e resolver problemas relacionados ao desempenho dos equipamentos;
• Monitorar os KPIs dos equipamentos;
• Garantir a segurança no trabalho e prevenir acidentes;
• Identificar oportunidades de melhoria em relação à operação dos equipamentos, procedimentos e processos de manutenção, e sugerir mudanças para melhorar a eficiência, a produtividade e a segurança;
• Preparar relatórios e documentos técnicos, tais como ordens de serviço, relatórios de manutenção, etc.;
• Treinar outros técnicos de manutenção quando necessário;
• Coordenar e supervisionar prestadores de serviços de manutenção terceirizados;
• Manter comunicação com outros departamentos, tais como engenharia, produção, qualidade, suprimentos, logística, HSE, finanças, administração, 

Do you have these requirements?

Ensino superior completo em engenharia.

Experiência com manutenção de grande porte

Conhecimento em ferramentas de analise de dados e KPIs

Your differences drive our performance

At Air Liquide, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, which means that, regardless of your gender identity, sexual orientation, color, age, religion, nationality or disability, we value a work environment made up of true stories, built by true people. 
Our processes reflect this, being diverse and free from any prejudice, therefore, we do not collect information such as date of birth, gender, marital status or full address in our selection stages. If this information is sent, it will be disregarded. 

We strongly believe that a diverse organization opens up opportunities for people to express their talent, both individually and collectively, and helps foster our ability to innovate by living our fundamentals, acting for our success and creating an engaging environment in a changing world.

title: Data Analyst
description:
About Match Affinity
Match Affinity is a division of Match Group that drives the fastest growing dating apps. Every month, millions of users come to our apps, like BLK and Chispa, to find matches and make great connections.
The Role
As a Data Analyst on our Product Analytics Team, you'll use data to understand our users -- what they need, what they do, how to retain them, and ultimately how to help them find the best dates.  Then you will partner with cross-functional teams to provide long-term strategic insights for our products.  You will also support business trends/forecasting and model the financial impact of new product ideas.

What You'll Do

  • A strong knowledge querying massive and complex datasets, analyzing, and driving key and actionable insights
  • Working with other cross-functional teams like Finance, CRM, Engineering and Business Intelligence; proactively engage other teams to identify and drive better user experience
  • Providing internal consulting to product management, marketing, finance, and CRM teams on A/B tests as they move initiatives from concept to market
  • Presenting technical content across business stakeholders
  • Working as the product owner of revenue and retention strategies for the product
  • Serving as the subject matter expert on applying various statistical methodologies towards distilling actionable insights
  • Researching issues about customer behavior/changes by analyzing relevant metrics, trends and supporting enterprise level initiatives
  • Supporting these products: Chispa, BLK, Upward, Yuzu

You might be a Match if you have:

  • 3+ years of hands on SQL (or structured data) experience along with advanced Excel Skills
  • Exposure to applied statistics (descriptive statistics, statistical testing, design of experiments, linear modeling, time series analysis etc); Python/SPSS/SAS/R experience a plus
  • Self-starter with good communications skills
  • You have experience going beyond number-crunching, reports, and dashboard creation -- you are able to understand the business impact of the data and make recommendations based on your findings
  • Excellent problem solving skills
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics,Economics, Computer Science, Engineering related field, Marketing, or MBA with quantitative focus
  • Experience in product analytics supporting digital applications including mobile apps & consumer internet is preferred
  • Fluent English is required.

Import to know:

  • As a global company operating across different time zones, flexibility in working hours will be important for this role.

  • Please submit your CV in English

title: Retention Marketing Specialist
description:
UN/COMMON is a digital experience and marketing agency that launches and grows the world's best emerging brands. We believe the future of consumer-facing brands starts with creating authentic stories built for the consumer first and brand second. We are extremely proud to work with revolutionary brands such as Selena Gomez's Rare Beauty, Dermalogica, Liquid Death, Lemon Perfect, and more.

We are an employee and customer-centric agency bringing mission first brand stories to life to benefit the greater good and better people's lives. And we have a TON of fun doing it

The Retention Marketing Specialist owns the day-to-day execution of email and SMS production for our clients. This includes project management, content planning, copy and creative briefs, HTML builds, QA, and scheduling. You will manage end-to-end production and keep timelines on track across design, strategy, and client teams. You will work closely with a Retention Marketing Strategist to support retention strategy, reporting, and ongoing optimization. If you enjoy organized workflows, sharp deadlines, clean builds, and improving the customer journey through thoughtful messaging, you will do well here.

What You Will Do

You will manage the full production process for email campaigns and automated flows, build emails in Klaviyo or similar ESPs, write on-brand copy, create clear briefs for the design team, QA content and logic, and schedule deployments. You will maintain the monthly content calendar, drive timelines with clients, and ensure all assets and approvals stay on track. You will support the Retention Marketing Strategist by pulling performance data, analyzing results, and developing recommendations. You will build automated workflows, segmentation, and list logic, maintain list hygiene, and work confidently with Shopify apps such as Yotpo, Loyalty Lion, JustUno, and Privy.

Based on our projected customer base growth, we foresee the need for a  Retention Marketing Specialist  within the next 2-4 months to ensure we can effectively manage and nurture our expanding user community.

Requirements

What You Need

  • 2 years of experience in retention marketing, specifically across email, SMS, CRM, or loyalty programs.
  • Hands-on experience with an Email Service Platform (ESP), with a strong preference for Klaviyo.
  • Strong copywriting skills for direct-to-consumer (DTC) e-commerce, with the ability to adapt tone and style to match different client brands.
  • A solid understanding of email analytics and the ability to translate data insights into actionable strategy.
  • Clear understanding of the difference between marketing campaigns and automated flows, and knowing when to deploy each.
  • Proficiency in building segmented customer lists using behavioral and transactional data.
  • Experience working within Shopify or directly supporting Shopify-based clients.
  • A proactive, organized approach, with the ability to think through the entire customer journey and work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative team.

What Success Looks Like

Your production process is smooth, predictable, and organized. Clients trust your communication and follow your timelines. Email and SMS performance improves because of your quality and attention to detail. Strategy and reporting move faster because you stay ahead of data and execution. You keep projects aligned, informed, and on schedule. You take ownership, ask smart questions, and keep work moving forward.

Benefits

This is a contract position
Up to 40 hours weekly
Remote
Selection Process

The selection process includes a video interview screening, followed by role-specific discussions (possible assessment) and a final leadership conversation.

Commitment to Inclusion

UN/COMMON is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees can thrive and bring their full selves to work.

About UN/COMMON

UN/COMMON has been recognized by Inc. Magazine as one of the fastest-growing private companies in America, reflecting our people-driven approach to growth, innovation, and excellence.

Agency Policy

Recruiting agencies are not authorized to submit candidates for this role. UN/COMMON does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from agencies.

title: Intern- Rio
description:
Description

ABS Interns are integrated into ABS business operations and will experience various aspects of engineering review, technical problem solving, and/or research and development. Interns will work with a designated advisor to learn and develop skills relating to ABS's core business functions while also assisting ABS with key deliverables. It is expected that interns will be assigned multiple projects for their respective departments throughout the course of their internship. Interns will work at the local ABS Consulting Office. 

What You Will Do:

  • The primary function of an intern is to develop skills and knowledge of ABS core business functions including but not limited to:
    • Engineering Plan Review.
    • Technical Plan Review.
    • Research and Product Development.
    • Operational Safety and Evaluation.
    • Data Science and Digital Services
  • Interns may provide engineering support in the form of design review and analysis assignments typically involving a major project or several smaller, less complex projects. Projects will vary in complexity and difficulty.
  • Under the supervision of an experienced engineer or engineering manager, interns may assist with a detailed engineering review of plans as assigned for compliance with applicable Rules, Regulations, and contract commitments.
  • Communicate the status of the current workload to all appropriate members of the team to ensure that the needs of the clients will be met.
  • May propose technical advice to field operations and other technical offices.
  • May propose new approaches to problems encountered and make recommendations for changes in methods, procedures, or designs.
  • May assist in the development of business performance metrics including the development and implementation of an ongoing business performance monitoring program, and the periodic analysis of operating results to determine causes, trends, etc.
  • May assist with the writing and presentation of technical papers and reports concerning areas of expertise and work performed.
  • May assist with Rule development projects as assigned.
  • Interns may collaborate with the digital team and with other departments such as services, class, project management, commercial operations, etc.
  • Intern may assist with data collection efforts for data quality improvement, in both existing and new data streams to support overall business goals.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in progress in Chemical Engineering (other related Engineering degrees – e.g., Mechanical, Production, Safety, Process – may be considered).
  • Currently enrolled from the 6th semester (or equivalent) onwards.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong interest in risk analysis, process safety and process engineering, especially in sectors such as marine/offshore, oil & gas and mining.
  • Availability to work 30 hours per week (e.g., 6 hours per day, Monday to Friday), during business hours.
  • Intermediate knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) – especially Excel for data treatment and KPI/risk indicator analysis.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English (and Portuguese).
  • Organization, attention to detail and interest in quality, risk and safety from a systems and process perspective.
  • Analytical mindset and genuine interest in working with data, engineering information and risk scenarios.
  • Proactivity and curiosity to understand client processes, technologies and risk scenarios in marine/offshore, oil & gas, mining and other industrial sectors.
  • Attention to detail and rigor in technical documentation, records and analyses.
  • Teamwork and collaboration, with ability to interact with multidisciplinary technical teams (engineering, operations, safety, quality, etc.).
  • Good organizational skills to manage multiple analytical tasks and deadlines.
  • Ethical behavior, focus on safety and alignment with ABS values of integrity and responsibility.

It would be nice if you had: 

  • Academic or extracurricular experience related to process safety, risk assessment, reliability, process simulation or industrial operations.
  • Basic understanding of risk analysis methods (e.g., HAZID, HAZOP, Bow-tie, LOPA, FMEA) and/or management systems (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO – even if only from university courses.
  • Familiarity with process flowcharts, PFDs, P&IDs and basic process engineering concepts (mass/energy balance, unit operations, etc.).
  • Experience with spreadsheets and basic data analysis (advanced Excel, simple dashboards, basic BI tools) is a plus.

Reporting Relationships:

You'll work alongside engineer colleagues reporting into a Senior Manager. colleguages 

Important: This internship does not involve laboratory activities. It is a position focused on theoretical and analytical work, risk and process evaluation, data analysis and technical documentation.

title: Account Manager
description:
At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 250 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data

For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data, quickly, dependably, and at scale. And today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Today, over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.
We are looking for an Account Manager to come and join our team, you will work closely with internal functions (Finance, Project Management, Legal, Professional Services) to execute account retention and growth strategies for Zyte's strategic accounts.  

Customer satisfaction, business retention, and portfolio growth are the key drivers of success for this position. 

Requirements

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the lead point of contact for a defined portfolio of existing business accounts.
  • Cultivate meaningful and long-lasting client relationships.
  • Negotiate contracts and close agreements to maximize profits.
  • Develop trusted advisor relationships with key accounts, customer stakeholders and executive sponsors.
  • Ensure the timely and successful delivery of our solutions according to customer needs and objectives.
  • Clearly communicate the progress of monthly/quarterly initiatives to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Develop new business with existing clients and/or identify areas of improvement to meet sales quotas.
  • Forecast and track key account metrics (e.g. quarterly sales results and annual forecasts).
  • Prepare reports on account status.
  • Visiting clients and engaging with them on in person meetings
  • Assist with challenging client requests or issue escalations as needed.
  • Manage a set of Enterprise Accounts in the Americas market, individual account value between approximately $40k and $200k in annual revenues.

Requirements:

  • 3+ years in an Account Management role.
  • Demonstrated ability to consistently meet and/or exceed sales quotas in revenue retention and account expansion.
  • Energy, enthusiasm and the ability to work well under pressure in meeting deadlines and achieving goals.
  • Strong deal closing and negotiation skills in Large Enterprise and Mid-market accounts
  • High level of analytical and organisational skills, and excellent attention to detail.
  • Understanding of data harvesting / web crawling a plus - but not necessary.
  • Previous experience working in consultative selling within Professional Services and SaaS Products is a must.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Commercially savvy within a Tech Scaleup company, with a proven track-record of delivering/over-delivering against Sales quotas. 
  • Demonstrated experience using sales analytics and funnel management techniques to drive productivity, pipeline management, and accurate forecasting.
  • Proven track record of collaborating with Customer Success teams to grow and expand Enterprise accounts.

Benefits

By joining the Zyte team, you will:

  • Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team.
  • Have the freedom & flexibility to work remotely.
  • Get the chance to work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools.

title: Country Sales Director
description:
Company Background

Our client is a subsidiary of a large industrial group specializing in industrial supply chain technology and services, with an estimated market value of approximately USD 5 billion.

They support the industrial sector through an integrated supply chain + technology + services model and operate a B2B procurement platform for industrial products. The company serves more than 7,000 key account clients and over 8 million SMEs, supported by approximately 30,000 suppliers and a catalog of more than 40 million SKUs.

The company is actively expanding its international and overseas business, providing one-stop MRO procurement solutions across Southeast Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and South America.

Role Overview

The Country Sales Director is responsible for key account management, B2B sales strategy, MRO solution development, revenue growth, team leadership, and market analysis.

The role reports to the Country General Manager and directly manages 5–6 Key Account Sales Managers.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Key Account Management

  • Manage and develop long-term relationships with key account (KA) customers.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of customer business models, procurement needs, and growth strategies.
  • Conduct regular customer communication and site visits to identify changing needs and provide professional recommendations.

MRO Solution Development

  • Design and deliver customized MRO product and service solutions aligned with customer operational and procurement requirements.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to deliver end-to-end procurement solutions, including demand analysis, product selection, and after-sales support.

Sales Strategy & Revenue Growth

  • Develop and execute B2B sales strategies and key account growth plans to achieve revenue and performance targets.
  • Identify new business opportunities through market research, customer insights, and industry analysis.
  • Drive market expansion and increase market share within the MRO and industrial supplies sector.

Team Leadership & Sales Management

  • Lead, train, and coach the key account sales team to improve performance and professional capabilities.
  • Establish efficient sales operations and customer service processes to improve team productivity and customer satisfaction.

Market Research & Competitive Analysis

  • Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and industry developments.
  • Adjust customer strategies to strengthen the company's competitive positioning.
  • Contribute to the development and optimization of key account policies and commercial strategies.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or higher; industrial engineering or related fields preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in B2B sales, key account management, industrial sales, or MRO-related roles.
  • Proven experience managing large enterprise clients or strategic accounts.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, international business environment.
  • Proficiency in standard office software.
  • Fluent in Mandarin and English; proficiency in Malay is a plus.

  • Realizar o planejamento e execução de relatórios geográficos com análises espaciais;
  • Analisar a cartografia (cartas geográficas) e arruamento (distribuição das ruas dos loteamentos) para atualização de topologia (descrever a localização e geometria de um mapa), utilizando corretamente os sistemas de coordenadas e as projeções;
  • Realizar a captura e conversão de dados geográficos, digitalizar entidades geométricas e gerenciar tabelas de atributos para integração com o Sistemas de Informação Geográfica (GIS);
  • Gerenciar diferentes formatos de camadas (vértices definidos por um par de coordenadas): vetoriais, raster, entre outros, assegurando o melhor formato para cada coordenada;
  • Analisar bases de dados e geoestatísticos, interpretando mapas com variáveis georreferenciadas, atualizando o sistema com os resultados obtidos;

Na Iguá Saneamento valorizamos a diferença em todos os contextos e trabalhamos para promover uma cultura ética e inclusiva sempre. VENHA TRABALHAR COM A GENTE

Em 2017, nascemos com um propósito:
ser a MELHOR empresa de saneamento PARA o Brasil.
Desde então, nos consolidamos como uma das principais empresas do setor no país e estamos presentes em seis estados brasileiros (Alagoas, Mato Grosso, São Paulo, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro e Sergipe), beneficiando milhões de pessoas por meio de nossas concessões e parcerias público-privadas. Mais do que uma atividade empresarial, encaramos a universalização do saneamento básico como um compromisso de larga escala com a vida, com as pessoas, com o meio ambiente, com nossos parceiros e com o desenvolvimento sustentável do Brasil. Esse propósito guia nossas decisões e reforça, todos os dias, o nosso compromisso em cada gota.

O nosso jeito de ser é marcado por um DNA inovador, que promove um ambiente acolhedor, respeitoso e repleto de aprendizados, gerando impacto positivo na sociedade. A valorização e o respeito às diferenças fazem parte da nossa cultura, promovendo uma atuação ética, inclusiva e um ambiente psicologicamente seguro para mulheres, pessoas com deficiência, pessoas negras, pessoas LGBTQIA+, independentemente de crenças, idade ou qualquer outro marcador social ou identitário. Buscamos equidade e respeito em nossas equipes e acreditamos na força de cada individualidade para gerar transformação. Já somos mais de
2.800 colaboradores
e seguimos com perspectivas de ir ainda mais longe.

Você já se perguntou qual é o seu propósito e que história deseja escrever para a sua vida e carreira? Sempre sonhou em ter um papel protagonista e impactar positivamente a vida de milhares de pessoas? Aqui, você pode fazer parte dessa transformação.

Vamos construir um futuro melhor, Iguá Saneamento.

title: Partnership Officer
description:
The Partnership Officer will play a key role in expanding our business by cultivating and managing relationships with a diverse range of partners. This role requires a highly organized and motivated individual with excellent relationship management skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Responsibilities

  • Create a systematic, process-driven approach for partner outreach and relationship management.
  • Develop an on-boarding plan and certification program to the partners to be completed following the enablement and orientation sessions.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to develop and implement joint marketing, sales, and support initiatives.
  • Collaborate with senior management, Business Development teams, and Strategy Manager to align our internal goals with new and existing partner relationships in LATAM.
  • Represent ProgressSoft at industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities to promote brand awareness and build strategic relationships.
  • Negotiate partnership agreements and contracts, ensuring terms are mutually beneficial and aligned with ProgressSoft´s objectives.
  • Develop a "Partner Kit" and collaborate with the marketing team to ensure partners receive the appropriate materials including branding guidelines, product summaries and presentations as applicable.
  • Work in liaison with the Business Development member handling the assigned territory to align on partnership agreement scopes, quotas, products covered, exclusivity, etc...
  • Maintain an ongoing relationship with current partners and offer new ways to grow the partnership.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers at partner organizations.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams, including Business Development, Marketing, strategy, Product Development, and Operations, to support partnership initiatives and drive results.
  • Identify and source partnership opportunities through inbound lead follow-up and outbound cold calls, emails, and client visits in LATAM.
  • Proactively seek out new partnership opportunities that align with the company's strategic goals, Business Development team's needs, and potentially complimentary products.
  • Analyze potential partnerships to assess strategic fit, value proposition, and potential ROI.
  • Stay up to date on industry trends, competitor activities, and identify emerging technologies and partners.
  • Forecast, measure, and report the results of various projects with partners, including co-created and/or co-branded content promotions, lead sharing, and/or event partnerships.
  • Analyze partnership performance, challenges, and opportunities to provide regular reports and insights to internal stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Possesses 3-5 years of experience in partnership management. 
  • Experienced in the IT and banking industry best practices, with a strong understanding of emerging technologies and their impact on financial services. 
  • Excellent knowledge of local LATAM payments infrastructure & industry.
  • Proven track record of successfully developing and managing partnerships.
  • Ability to track and analyze partnership performance. 
  • Ability to evolve in a complex environment.
  • Ability to operate with complete independence and autonomy.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent negotiation and strategic thinking skills. 
  • Proficiency in written and verbal communication in English is a must.

description:
We are seeking a professional for the Marine Engineer position to work at our office located in Rio Corporate Office dedicated to Guyana project (MOG).

This position is responsible for be acting as the Technical Authority to evaluate and respond to Management of Change (MOC) and Technical Assistance (TA) requests, ensuring technical integrity and compliance with MODEC standards for Integrity Engineer discipline and responsible for leading the team which will be conducting Root Cause Analyses (RCA) in accordance with MODEC guidelines to identify and address the underlying causes of technical issues for Integrity Engineer discipline.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
To perform functions such as:

  • Technical Authority for the evaluation and response to MOC and TA requests, ensuring all technical solutions are compliant with MODEC standards and industry regulations.
  • Review, assess, and approve technical changes, modifications, and deviations, providing clear recommendations and justifications.
  • Perform Root Cause Analyses (RCA) for incidents, failures, and recurring issues, ensuring thorough investigation and documentation in line with MODEC procedures.
  • Develop and communicate technical reports and recommendations based on RCA findings to prevent recurrence and improve operational reliability.
  • Ensure all technical evaluations and recommendations are properly documented and communicated to relevant stakeholders, including offshore and onshore teams.
  • Support the implementation of corrective and preventive actions resulting from MOC, TA, and RCA processes, monitoring their effectiveness.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of MODEC guidelines, industry standards, and best practices to ensure technical solutions are current and effective.
  • Provide technical guidance and support to operations, maintenance, and engineering teams as required.
  • Participate in audits, reviews, and technical meetings to ensure continuous improvement and compliance with company policies.
  • Participate in offshore visits as required to support technical evaluations, investigations, and implementation of solutions.

Requisitos e qualificações
Requerimentos:

  • Bachelor's degree of Marine Engineering is required.
  • MBA is a competitive edge.
  • Active CREA registration.
  • Overall experience is expected.
  • Experience in Offshore/Onshore Production Process on Oil & Gas is expected.
  • Fluent English is required.

  • Basic CMMS systems knowledge is a competitive edge (SAP preferred).

title: ENGENHEIRO DE MARINHA
description:
We are seeking a professional for the Marine Engineer position to work at our office located in Rio Corporate Office dedicated to Guyana project (MOG).

This position is responsible for be acting as the Technical Authority to evaluate and respond to Management of Change (MOC) and Technical Assistance (TA) requests, ensuring technical integrity and compliance with MODEC standards for Integrity Engineer discipline and responsible for leading the team which will be conducting Root Cause Analyses (RCA) in accordance with MODEC guidelines to identify and address the underlying causes of technical issues for Integrity Engineer discipline.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

To perform functions such as:

  • Technical Authority for the evaluation and response to MOC and TA requests, ensuring all technical solutions are compliant with MODEC standards and industry regulations.
  • Review, assess, and approve technical changes, modifications, and deviations, providing clear recommendations and justifications.
  • Perform Root Cause Analyses (RCA) for incidents, failures, and recurring issues, ensuring thorough investigation and documentation in line with MODEC procedures.
  • Develop and communicate technical reports and recommendations based on RCA findings to prevent recurrence and improve operational reliability.
  • Ensure all technical evaluations and recommendations are properly documented and communicated to relevant stakeholders, including offshore and onshore teams.
  • Support the implementation of corrective and preventive actions resulting from MOC, TA, and RCA processes, monitoring their effectiveness.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of MODEC guidelines, industry standards, and best practices to ensure technical solutions are current and effective.
  • Provide technical guidance and support to operations, maintenance, and engineering teams as required.
  • Participate in audits, reviews, and technical meetings to ensure continuous improvement and compliance with company policies.
  • Participate in offshore visits as required to support technical evaluations, investigations, and implementation of solutions.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requerimentos:

  • Bachelor's degree of Marine Engineering is required.
  • MBA is a competitive edge.
  • Active CREA registration.
  • Overall experience is expected.
  • Experience in Offshore/Onshore Production Process on Oil & Gas is expected.
  • Fluent English is required.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office package knowledge is required.
  • Basic CMMS systems knowledge is a competitive edge (SAP preferred).
  • Basic Power BI knowledge is a competitive edge.

Informações adicionais

Being part of MODEC means being the PROTAGONIST of a CHALLENGING career and being in touch with the latest deep-water production systems, knowing that your career begins in BRAZIL, but your talent can take you anywhere in the WORLD.

  • If you want to be one of the greatest in the market, this is your opportunity
  • As a MULTICULTURAL company that respects DIVERSITY, we encourage PWD application in our process.

Na MODEC, o nosso maior ativo são as pessoas. Com mais de 55 anos de história e duas décadas de atuação no Brasil, somos uma empresa global em constante crescimento, presente em cinco continentes e referência na construção, afretamento e operação de plataformas offshore.

No Brasil, operamos 14 unidades de produção e temos duas em construção, reunindo mais de 3,3 mil profissionais que constroem, todos os dias, um futuro mais seguro, sustentável e inovador.

Aqui, valorizamos a diversidade, a inclusão e o desenvolvimento contínuo. Nosso ambiente é colaborativo e multicultural, guiado por um propósito: unir pessoas e tecnologias para transformar energia em oportunidades.

#BeMODEC | Um oceano de oportunidades.

Nossos benefícios

A MODEC valoriza cada pessoa, estando consciente de seu papel e importância dentro e fora do ambiente de trabalho. Esse cuidado é refletido nos benefícios que a empresa oferece às equipes, bem como aos seus familiares, parte fundamental do dia a dos nossos profissionais. Conheça abaixo os benefícios oferecidos:

  • Vales alimentação e refeição;

  • Previdência privada;
  • Participação dos lucros;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico extensivo a dependentes;

  • Acompanhamento da saúde dos empregados em casos de doenças crônicas;
  • Sala de amamentação para as empregadas lactantes, em nossos escritórios.

Career without borders

At MODEC, our greatest asset is our people. With more than 55 years of history and two decades operating in Brazil, we are a global company in constant growth, present on five continents and a reference in the construction, chartering, and operation of offshore platforms.

In Brazil, we operate 14 production units and have two under construction, bringing together more than 3,300 professionals who build, every day, a safer, more sustainable, and more innovative future.

Here, we value diversity, inclusion, and continuous development. Our environment is collaborative and multicultural, guided by a purpose: to unite people and technologies to transform energy into opportunities.

#BeMODEC | An ocean of opportunities.

Quem somos?

GSK é uma empresa Biofarmacêutica global com um propósito especial – Unir ciência, tecnologia e talento para vencer as doenças juntos. Avançar significa prevenir doenças, além de tratá-las. Nós buscamos impactar a saúde de 2.5 bilhões de pessoas ao redor do mundo nos próximos 10 anos.

Nosso sucesso depende de nossas pessoas. Nós queremos que a GSK seja um lugar onde as pessoas se sintam inspiradas, encorajadas e desafiadas para serem a melhor versão de si Um lugar onde as pessoas possam ser elas mesmas – se sentindo bem-vindas, valorizadas e inclusas. Onde elas possam continuar crescendo e se preocupar c--om seu bem-estar. Se você compartilha nossa ambição, junte-se a nós em nossa jornada de vencer as doenças juntos.

 
O que você fará?   

Nossa área de Pesquisa Clínica é responsável por planejar, implementar e gerenciar ensaios clínicos para testar a segurança e eficácia de um novo medicamento ou vacina seguindo diretrizes éticas e regulamentares sendo uma área de extrema relevância no campo da inovação em saúde.

  • Suporte na Gestão de Estudos Clínicos: Auxiliar os gerentes de estudos clínicos na coordenação e no acompanhamento de múltiplos estudos simultaneamente, garantindo a conformidade com prazos e requisitos de qualidade.

  • Apoio na Organização de Documentos: Auxiliar os gerentes de estudos clínicos na preparação, revisão e organização de arquivos regulatórios e documentos essenciais para os estudos.

  • Assistência na Preparação de Submissões Éticas: Apoiar os gerentes de estudos clínicos nos processos de submissão para CEP e CONEP.

  • Acompanhamento do Progresso dos Estudos: Auxiliar os gerentes de estudos clínicos a monitorar métricas de desempenho dos estudos e elaborar relatórios de progresso.

  • Participação em Reuniões de Equipe: Participar de reuniões de alinhamento de projetos, apoiando os gerentes na elaboração de atas e no acompanhamento de planos de ação.

  • Colaboração com Equipes Multidisciplinares: Dar suporte às atividades de outros setores e colaborar com as equipes para garantir a execução de atividades e o cumprimento dos processos e procedimentos operacionais.

  • Comunicação e Treinamento: Contribuir para a criação de materiais de suporte e informativos para centros de pesquisa, bem como na disseminação de treinamentos relacionados à área.

  • Verificação e acompanhamento de status de contratos de pesquisa clínica em sistemas dando suporte para coleta de assinaturas. Além disso, acompanhamento e controle de pagamentos relacionados a visitas de estudos clínicos e interface com o departamento financeiro para conferência e suporte ao faturamento

O que estamos buscando?

  • Pacote Office Intermediário.

  • Inglês Intermediário.

  • Boa comunicação, trabalho em equipe e proatividade são essenciais.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Garantir a segurança e a proteção do patrimônio, dos colaboradores e dos visitantes, monitorando e prevenindo atividades suspeitas ou ilegais, assegurando a ordem e o cumprimento das normas internas.

O vigilante é responsável por garantir a segurança e integridade das instalações e pessoas, prevenindo ações criminosas e respondendo prontamente a contingências. Este profissional deve ser atento, proativo e capaz de atuar de forma eficaz em situações de risco.

title: Especialista em Product Design
description:
A Zerezes nasceu do design, do seu olhar atento às pessoas, e da vontade de redesenhar o que não funciona.

Acreditamos que os óculos são uma ferramenta de expressão do nosso estilo e personalidade, mas sabemos que essa não é a forma com ele é percebido pelas pessoas, que enxergam os óculos como algo funcional e pouco atraente.

Queremos transformar o jeito que as pessoas compram e se relacionam com seus óculos de grau, porque achamos que dessa maneira, melhoramos não somente como elas se veem, mas também como se relacionam com o mundo.

A Zerezes vive um momento de forte expansão e amadurecimento e para isso estamos montando nosso novo time de Produtos Digitais com a missão de transformar a experiência do online ao físico. Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Product Design apaixonado(a) por resolver problemas complexos e criar jornadas fluidas e intuitivas que gerem valor real para o usuário e para o negócio.

Se você tem uma mentalidade data-driven, experiência sólida em discovery, e um histórico comprovado na construção de produtos digitais de alta qualidade e escalabilidade, venha fazer parte da fundação do nosso time

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Liderar Discovery Contínuo: Identificar proativamente oportunidades, problemas e necessidades reais dos usuários no contexto do varejo, utilizando pesquisa qualitativa e quantitativa (como testes de usabilidade, entrevistas e análise de dados);
  • Definir e Validar Soluções de Ponta a Ponta: Estruturar hipóteses de produtos e serviços digitais, desenvolver fluxos, wireframes e protótipos interativos de alta fidelidade para validar conceitos e garantir clareza para o desenvolvimento;
  • Colaboração Multifuncional: Trabalhar em conjunto com o time de produto e de engenharia para traduzir insights em um backlog estruturado, garantindo o alinhamento entre Design, Negócio e Tecnologia;
  • Garantir a Qualidade e Consistência: Assegurar a consistência e a excelência do design de acordo com a identidade da marca e as melhores práticas de acessibilidade;
  • Tomada de Decisão Baseada em Dados: Analisar métricas e feedbacks de uso para aprimorar continuamente as soluções de design, garantindo o compromisso com resultados e metas;
  • Visão Estratégica: Auxiliar na definição da visão e estratégia de produto junto às lideranças, mantendo um olhar atento às tendências do mercado de varejo e inovação digital;
  • Mentoria e Compartilhamento: Apoiar a equipe na aplicação de melhores práticas de design e compartilhar insights com stakeholders e restante do time.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência Sólida como Product Designer, com portfólio significativo que evidêncie suas contribuições, especialmente em produtos de médio/grande porte ou em ambientes dinâmicos e de rápido crescimento;
  • Forte Atuação em Discovery e com habilidade avançada em pesquisa qualitativa e quantitativa para embasar decisões e experiência na condução de workshops e dinâmicas de cocriação;
  • Proficiência Técnica com conhecimento avançado em design visual e fluência em ferramentas de design e prototipação (Figma é essencial);
  • Design System: Garantir consistência na identidade visual das soluções, atuando em conjunto com o time de Estúdio;
  • Pensamento Analítico e capacidade de utilizar dados e métricas para estruturar e validar hipóteses rapidamente;
  • Excelente comunicação oral e escrita para articular decisões de design de forma clara para diferentes níveis de stakeholders;
  • Auto-gestão eficaz da carga de trabalho, organização para gerenciar prioridades de forma independente e flexibilidade para lidar com mudanças de escopo.

Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Ter atuado no mercado de Varejo, E-commerce ou Marketplaces;
  • Experiência prévia em produtos digitais B2B e/ou B2C no segmento de omnichannel;
  • Conhecimentos avançados e/ou experiência anterior de atuação direta em UX Research ou UX Writing;

The Service Provider will ensure CTR and sub‑CTR work complies with CPY and Project Specifications for WAG Manifolds and Foundations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct inspection of welds and welding processes to verify compliance with WPS/PQR, codes, standards, and project specifications.
  • Perform welding inspections before, during, and after welding per ISO 3834‑2 requirements.
  • Apply extensive inspection experience (minimum 10 years) with CRA materials, including Super Duplex (Pipe/Forging/HIPPED), Inconel 625, and LAS (F22).
  • Inspect buttering, overlay, and girth welds using Inconel 625 and Alloy 59 consumables.
  • Use advanced inspection techniques:Interpret WPS and PQR to validate conformance during production.
  • Visual
  • Ultrasonic
  • Phase Array Ultrasonic Testing (PAUT)
  • Magnetic Particle
  • Liquid Penetrant
  • Radiographic Testing
  • Inspect incoming materials against requirements and mill certificates.
  • Participate in root cause analysis for welding defects and contribute to corrective action planning with welding engineers and production teams.
  • Identify and report deviations or unacceptable conditions that may impact SPS equipment fabrication, installation, or production.
  • Prepare detailed weekly inspection reports.
  • Collaborate with Company Site Representative and CPY Material Engineer on welding/NDT/material issues.
  • Stop work in cases of non‑conformity and reassess before resuming.
  • Work with contractors and subcontractors to resolve issues without impacting schedule while maintaining required quality standards.
  • Drive closure of non‑conformities in a timely manner.
  • Follow up on welding activities and report findings to the project team.
  • Participate in COMPANY and contractor audits and follow up on issue resolution.

CONTEXT & ENVIRONMENT

The role supports the execution phase of a major project in Suriname (Block 58 offshore).

The multidisciplinary Suriname GPI team coordinates project activities for deep and shallow-water developments.

Technical challenges include:

  • Reservoir development
  • FPSO
  • Subsea production/injection systems

The objective is to maximize economic performance through optimized reserves, schedule, cost efficiency, reduced GHG emissions, and strong technical and H3SE standards.

DURATION / LOCATION

  • Start Date: 1 March 2026
  • Duration: 1 year, renewable up to mid‑2028 (fabrication delivery)
  • Renewable: Yes
  • Location: Rio, Brazil, with frequent travel to Distrito Industrial – Vespasiano/MG
  • Status: Residential

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

  • Prior experience with WAG Manifolds and Subsea Structures
  • 15+ years of welding inspection experience with deep understanding of welding processes
  • Certified Welding Inspector (CWI), CSWIP 3.1 or 3.2, or equivalent
  • NDT Level 3 certification (UT & PAUT, RT, DPI)
  • Strong ability to interpret engineering drawings and specifications
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
  • Languages: Fluent English (Portuguese/French is a plus)

DIVERSIDADE: A YDUQS valoriza a diversidade e as informações adicionais prestadas nos campos de diversidade são muito importantes para nós, por isso pedimos para que não deixe de responder.

NA ESTÁCIO, REVELAMOS O QUE HÁ DE MAIS BRILHANTE EM CADA UM.

Somos uma das maiores e mais respeitadas instituições do setor educacional brasileiro. Há mais de 50 anos, proporcionamos acesso a um ensino de qualidade em larga escala. Estamos presentes em todo território nacional, ofertando cursos de graduação, pós-graduação e cursos livres, nas modalidades presencial e digital, e nossa busca constante pela qualidade acadêmica e investimentos na área de ensino garantem que as nossas instituições e cursos sejam reconhecidos pelo MEC com elevados conceitos de qualidade.

Sempre nos dedicamos a lapidar talentos para revelar a vocação de cada estudante. Os alunos também sabem que nós reconhecemos, em cada um, um diamante a ser polido. Juntos, formamos uma comunidade de diferentes perfis e sonhos, presente em todos os cantos do Brasil. Mais do que dar um diploma, a Estácio cria condições para que novas histórias de vida sejam escritas.

PROPÓSITO

Educar para transformar.

VISÃO

Oferecer a melhor experiência e aprendizagem a cada vez mais alunos, com eficiência, uso intensivo de tecnologias e valorização das pessoas, garantindo que nossos estudantes estejam preparados para os desafios do mercado.

Foco no aluno

Todos nós trabalhamos para o aluno, temos paixão por educar.

Senso de dono

Agimos como donos, com orgulho de cada uma de nossas entregas.

Foco No Resultado

Cada esforço gera impacto real e sustentável.

Superamos expectativas, entregando a melhor formação e experiência, em todos os segmentos que atuamos

Valorização Das Pessoas

Sentimos orgulho em trabalhar aqui. Desenvolvemos as pessoas e valorizamos entregas de excelência

Inovação e Tecnologia

Incorporamos tecnologia em todos os processos, potencializando alunos, professores e

colaboradores.

Diversidade e ética

Fazemos o certo, valorizamos as diferenças.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI ENCONTRAR POR AQUI?

Contamos com profissionais que valorizam a inovação em um ambiente diverso, com simplicidade e ética. Nossas iniciativas sempre têm o aluno no centro da decisão, pois consideramos o seu sucesso como nosso.

Com uma forte apropriação da cultura digital, atuamos por meio do desenvolvimento de metodologias e de conteúdos que refletem os desafios e as necessidades do nosso tempo.

Temos um grupo de alta liderança extremamente sênior e competente, que nos guia com segurança sobre a estratégia da organização.

Estamos dedicados em contribuir para redução do problema estratégico de Diversidade & Inclusão no país, implementando um programa estruturado e colocando o tema constantemente em pauta com a alta liderança.

Somos vidrados no engajamento dos colaboradores e implementamos um programa estruturado de eNPS, com 5 squads rodando em paralelo com foco em melhoria contínua na experiência do colaborador. Em 3 meses de lançamento já implementamos 14 melhorias focadas em oportunidade de carreira e infra digital.

title: Estágio Short Job
description:
Sobre a Área
A área de Automation atua em diversas iniciativas internas do Banco, exercendo papel fundamental na transformação digital do banco. A área possui um importante papel dentro do BTG, possibilitando a escalabilidade de novos negócios e dos já existentes, por meio de soluções de automação modernas e disruptivas, gerando dados que auxiliam na gestão das áreas e dão insumo para a tomada de decisão gerencial.

O time é dividido em squads de acordo com as áreas de negócio do banco permitindo que os(as) desenvolvedores(as) possam ser aprofundar nos processos de negócio das áreas que entendem bem como garantir a melhoria contínua das soluções que são disponibilizadas para que nossos clientes internos.

Sobre o Programa de Short Job em Automation
Nesse programa você vai ter a oportunidade de conhecer os bastidores do maior banco de investimentos da América Latina, entender como são operados e comercializados os diversos produtos oferecidos pelo BTG, e construir soluções que mudem o dia a dia de diversas áreas.

Nossos estagiários ficam 2 meses no time sempre acompanhados de um especialista técnico para auxiliar em qualquer dúvida ou problema que venha a ter. Aqueles(as) estagiários(as) com bom desempenho, podem ter o contrato renovado por mais 2 meses

O Processo Seletivo Possui As Seguintes Etapas

  • Inscrição;
  • Teste de habilidades cognitivas do parceiro Criteria (você receberá um link por email para a realização do teste. Lembre-se de checar a caixa de spam também)
  • Banca: avançando no processo seletivo, você será convidado para uma etapa online para podermos nos conhecer melhor. Ao longo da dinâmica será realizado um case e/ou um desafio prático para avaliarmos suas habilidades;
  • Teste Técnico do hackerrank.

No Seu Dia-a-dia Você Vai

  • Utilizar serviços na AWS para alavancar o desenvolvimento das soluções;
  • Construir telas de front-end em ReactJS e Flask;
  • Programar back-end e APIs de serviços em Python;
  • Entender como criar processos padronizados;
  • Lidar com diversos tipos de produtos financeiros;
  • Desenvolver as soluções que foram definidas, e garantir a qualidade da entrega;
  • Prestar suporte quando alguma solução para de funcionar como deveria;
  • Manter um relacionamento próximo com os usuários, e mantê-los informados sobre o a evolução e andamento das soluções;
  • Desenvolver soluções de alto impacto, integrando diferentes tecnologias;
  • Garantir a estabilidade e o funcionamento das soluções do time.

O Que Buscamos Em Novos Talentos

  • Curiosidade:

  • para aprender novas linguagens de programação;

  • para entender os processos de ponta a ponta, e aprender como é o dia a dia de um Banco;
  • para adquirir mais conhecimentos sobre produtos financeiros;

  • sobre o universo da tecnologia e cacidade de reconhecer sua aplicabilidade no dia a dia.

  • Paixão:

  • por trabalhar em equipe e ter a vontade de espalhar seus conhecimentos;

  • por tecnologia, mas que também amam conhecer e entender o business;

  • por dados e capazes de enxergar como trabalhá-lo para auxiliar a tomada de decisão.

  • Entusiasmo:

  • para entregar as melhores soluções, todos os dias;

  • por tecnologia, principalmente Python;
  • para mudar processos que já não funcionam tão bem quanto no passado.

E Para Isso Precisamos Que Você

  • Esteja cursando regularmente um curso de formação superior (nível bacharel ou tecnólogo);
  • Tenha disponibilidade de trabalhar no mínimo 2 meses conosco;
  • Tenha disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente no escritório de São Paulo ou Rio de Janeiro;
  • Preferencialmente já tenha feito projetos relacionados a tecnologia;
  • Tenha conhecimento em base lógica de programação.

title: ENGENHEIRO ELETRICISTA
description:
We are seeking a professional for the Electrical Engineer position to work at our office located in Rio Corporate Office dedicated to Guyana project (MOG).

This position is responsible for be acting as the Technical Authority to evaluate and respond to Management of Change (MOC) and Technical Assistance (TA) requests, ensuring technical integrity and compliance with MODEC standards for Electrical Engineer discipline and responsible for leading the team which will be conducting Root Cause Analyses (RCA) in accordance with MODEC guidelines to identify and address the underlying causes of technical issues for Electrical Engineer discipline.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
To perform functions such as:

  • Technical Authority for the evaluation and response to MOC and TA requests, ensuring all technical solutions are compliant with MODEC standards and industry regulations.
  • Review, assess, and approve technical changes, modifications, and deviations, providing clear recommendations and justifications.
  • Perform Root Cause Analyses (RCA) for incidents, failures, and recurring issues, ensuring thorough investigation and documentation in line with MODEC procedures.
  • Develop and communicate technical reports and recommendations based on RCA findings to prevent recurrence and improve operational reliability.
  • Ensure all technical evaluations and recommendations are properly documented and communicated to relevant stakeholders, including offshore and onshore teams.
  • Support the implementation of corrective and preventive actions resulting from MOC, TA, and RCA processes, monitoring their effectiveness.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of MODEC guidelines, industry standards, and best practices to ensure technical solutions are current and effective.
  • Provide technical guidance and support to operations, maintenance, and engineering teams as required.
  • Participate in audits, reviews, and technical meetings to ensure continuous improvement and compliance with company policies.
  • Participate in offshore visits as required to support technical evaluations, investigations, and implementation of solutions.

Requisitos e qualificações
Requerimentos:

  • Bachelor's degree of Engineering is required.
  • MBA is a competitive edge.
  • Active CREA registration.
  • Overall experience is expected.
  • Experience in Offshore/Onshore Production Process on Oil & Gas is expected.
  • Fluent English is required.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office package knowledge is required.
  • Basic CMMS systems knowledge is a competitive edge (SAP preferred).
  • Basic Power BI knowledge is a competitive edge.

Informações adicionais

means being the PROTAGONIST of a CHALLENGING career and being in touch with the latest deep-water production systems, knowing that your career begins in BRAZIL, but your talent can take you anywhere in the WORLD.

title: Production Operator
description:
The Production Operator will be responsible for safely operating and monitoring the facility's process and utility systems to ensure stable and efficient offshore production. This includes operating separation, compression, dehydration, seawater injection and utility systems, preparing equipment for maintenance, performing process analyses, supporting emergency response actions, and ensuring compliance with operational and safety procedures. The role contributes to maintaining safe operations, equipment integrity, and consistent production performance.

Responsibilities

  • Start/stop and operate oil and produced gas separation plants, gas compressors, glycol dehydration, HPU systems, produced water systems and utilities.
  • Understand the safe operating limits of these systems and parameter control.
  • Start / stop and operate water cooling, coarse / fine filtration, deaeration and seawater injection systems. Understand the safe operating limits of these systems.
  • Philosophy of isolations, Permit to Work, Operational, Fire and Gas, and COSHH Task Evaluation. Basic knowledge of cause and effect.
  • Knowledge of the actions and duties of emergency event response as required in abnormal / emergency situations.
  • Knowledge and understanding of actions required to minimize commercial loss while maintaining safe operation. Prepare / isolate equipment or systems for intrusive maintenance.
  • Responsible for conservation and preservation as well as first line maintenance on production system (valves and equipment).
  • Assist and stand-by when Electrical / Instrumentation and mechanical technicians are working on process systems in order to keep the system safe to perform work.
  • Perform oil and gas pipeline cleaning activities using pigging technology.
  • Communicate effectively with co-workers and communicate any deficiencies to the Control Room Operator and Production Supervisor. Control, operate and optimize daily chemical dosing rates associated with the process system.
  • General organization and maintenance duties in work area.
  • Perform dew point analysis, TOG analysis, BSW analysis, pH analysis
  • Perform external readings according to the frequency defined by the PSUPT, verify the values with the Control Room Operator and report any deviations found to the supervisor, defining corrective measures.
  • To generate clear and simple reports aligned with the task.
  • Other duties that are related to the function, as instructed, and requested by the Production Supervisor Maintain up-to-date certification applied to his/her function and medical certificates Participate in company training, as defined.
  • Ensure compliance with BW procedures as applied to your position, including the work permit system. Comply with all emergency tasks assigned to your role in the emergency response plan, when applicable.
  • Required to be fully familiar with and comply with the Company, Quality, Health, Safety and Environmental Policies and Procedures assigned to your title / position.
  • Anticipate and realize any unsafe condition and ensure that the correct actions are taken as per procedure. Responsible for your own safety and for the safety of your co-workers.

Education

  • Technical or equivalent qualification from the country of origin.

Experience

  • Experience in offshore production operations or similar industrial environments.
  • Pre‑experience is not required for trainee positions.

Knowledge

  • Knowledge aligned with the company's Competence Assurance Assessment requirements.
  • Familiarity with production systems, utilities, chemical dosing, pigging operations, and laboratory/process analyses (dew point, TOG, BSW, pH).
  • Understanding of isolation philosophy, Permit to Work procedures, Fire & Gas principles, emergency response actions, and operational safety requirements.
